gemini.title: Scotland Demography Migration Datazone
gemini.abstract: Scotland Demography Migration Datazone is an authoritative dataset published by National Records of Scotland. It contains records relating to scotland demography migration datazone.
gemini.lineage: Published by National Records of Scotland as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
